name: Alex Moon
originStory: You were born to Susan Moon and Robert Moon, married eight years by the time you arrived. She was out of work, he was between jobs. Nothing extravagant, but nobody checked the price of things. You were the second child. Karen came first and never let you forget it. Your mother Susan sang in a church choir every Sunday and made you stand next to her. In Amsterdam, in 2026. Nobody there had any idea what you would become.

timeline.text: Born in Amsterdam to Susan Moon and Robert Moon — a comfortable household.

productions.title: Paper Cousin
productions.premise: A daughter who stayed away too long comes back to a terrace due for clearance. A will leaves everything to one of them, and it is too late to be fair about it.

scene.label: Why does she do it
scene.hint: Any answer is defensible. Only one of them is yours.
scene.title: Paper Cousin
scene.line: Rosalind Varga will not roll until you answer one question, and then they will spend the day checking whether you meant it.
scene.page: Today's pages: the middle of it — it is too late to be fair about it.
